structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Special license plates displaying a scenic design of Virginia; fees
law.text: On receipt of an application, the Commissioner shall issue license plates displaying a scenic design of Virginia. These license plates shall be valid for whatever period the Commissioner determines. For each set of license plates issued under this section the Commissioner shall charge, in addition to the prescribed cost of state license plates, a one-time fee of ten dollars at the time the plates are issued.
